_comment: Tracked in git, so anyone who can push can change it and it takes effect on the next round (~11 min). Runtime state lives in state.json, which is NOT tracked.
_enabled: false makes every round collect and decide but fire nothing. Use it to hand the account's 5-unrated-per-10-minutes budget back to a human who wants to test their own bot -- the farm otherwise consumes almost all of it.
_yield_until: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. '2026-08-06T18:30:00Z'. Fires nothing until then, then resumes by itself. Prefer this over enabled:false -- it cannot be forgotten.
_test_next: Builds to test ahead of UCB selection, as 'name@commit' or 'name@commit:rounds' (5 matches per round, default 1). e.g. ['spar_econ@aad5f44:2']. Uploaded from git history on first use. Each entry is consumed once -- re-adding the same string will not re-queue it, change the commit or use --test-next locally.
